description: make cocotb: an APB3 slave under five cocotb tests. The marks of the run (test_apb.py, python/wavelens_cocotb.py) go into the view with --marks; the Makefile passes the dump with --waves.

page.title: APB3 · five cocotb tests marked up on the waves
page.intro: cocotb drives an APB3 register slave. Each test writes its number into the testbench's TEST_CASE, its phases into TEST_STEP, and says what it does: its span and bookmarks come from the run, in the colour of its result. The last test finds a bug of the slave.
